sections.heading: Is your Economics tutor legally permitted to teach in the UAE?
paragraphs: This is the question with the clearest answer and the least coverage. Private tutoring in the UAE is regulated by permit. The MoHRE private tuition work permit was introduced by Ministerial Resolution No. 710 of 2023 Regarding the Introduction of Private Tuition Work Permits, and it is granted free of charge for two years. Eligible applicants include teachers registered in government or private schools, employees in the government and private sectors, unemployed individuals, school students aged 15 to 18, and university students. The official route is MoHRE's own service, Issuance of a New Work Permit - Private Tutor Licensing, applied for through the MoHRE smart app, website and e-services system, with a stated two-working-day completion time and no listed fee.

Two things follow for a Sharjah parent comparing quotes. Individuals offering private tutoring without a permit from MoHRE are subject to fines and penalties outlined in the applicable laws - no fine schedule is published, so no amount should be quoted at you by anybody, and a provider quoting one is guessing. And a tutoring operation with premises and staff is a different legal animal from an individual tutor: a training institute in Dubai needs a KHDA Educational Services Permit, which is a specific document issued to a specific entity. Nobody should describe themselves using a regulator's name as a credential without producing the number.

There is one more boundary worth knowing because it protects your child, not us. In Abu Dhabi, ADEK's professional-ethics rules for private and charter school staff prohibit teachers from providing paid private tutoring to students enrolled at their own school, and the MoHRE permit's code of conduct also bars serving students affiliated with the tutor's own school. That is press-reported rather than read off the policy document, so verify it against current ADEK material before relying on it. The practical rule is the same in any emirate: do not hire your child's own classroom teacher privately, however convenient it looks.

sections.heading: Online, in-home and group in this emirate - the comparison that decides the budget
paragraphs: Home tutoring is a real market in Sharjah and the question deserves a real answer rather than a sales line. In-home one-to-one in the UAE is quoted at roughly AED 180 to 500 an hour with travel included, and monthly in-home packages of AED 1,599 to 1,799 for four two-hour sessions appear on provider pages in this market. What that money buys is a tutor in the room and a tutor who had to get there. In Muwaileh, where a visiting tutor can run back-to-back sessions in one community, the travel overhead is small. In Khor Fakkan or Kalba it is prohibitive, and in Al Nahda at 6pm it is unpredictable in a way no price can fix.

IB Gram does not offer home visits in the UAE. That is not a hedge; it is the model. Home visits are a service we run only in India, and every UAE page on this site says the same thing. Sharjah lessons are delivered one-to-one over live video, in Gulf Standard Time, with the same tutor each week. The argument for it is specific rather than general: Economics HL Paper 3 has a small specialist pool anywhere in the world and an almost non-existent one inside a 20-minute drive of any given Sharjah address. Online delivery replaces the question of who is nearby with the question of who can mark the paper.

The format also changes what a session can contain. A shared screen holds the extract, the diagram and the marked script at once; a student can be given a timed Paper 3 question, hand it in as a photograph, and get it back annotated before the next session. None of that depends on being in the room, and all of it depends on the tutor having marked the component before. Group classes at a tuition centre remain the cheapest option per hour in this market and the weakest fit for a student who is the only Economics HL candidate in their year group, which in Sharjah is common.

sections.heading: Where Economics HL marks are actually lost, by topic
paragraphs: Economics HL candidates rarely fail on knowledge. They lose marks on four repeatable, diagnosable habits, and a tutor who knows the component can name which one is costing a given student their grade from two marked scripts. The first is diagram discipline: axes unlabelled, units missing, the new equilibrium not marked, and the diagram never referred to in the prose. In a 10-mark part (a) that is a straightforward loss of marks that cost nothing to secure.

The second is command-term blindness. Explain, analyse, evaluate, discuss and to what extent are not synonyms, and a student who answers all of them the same way scores the explanation marks and forfeits the judgement marks. The 15-mark part (b) and the Paper 3 recommendation both require a position taken and defended against its own trade-offs. The third is the HL quantitative extensions: the Keynesian multiplier, the Phillips curve, the Lorenz curve and the Gini coefficient, tariff, quota and subsidy calculations, terms of trade and exchange-rate arithmetic. These are mechanical and highly scorable, and they are routinely taught last and revised least.

The fourth is the portfolio, which sits at 20 per cent of the HL grade and is the only component where the student controls the conditions entirely. Commentaries that summarise an article instead of applying theory to it, that name a key concept without using it, or that miss the rubric requirements on unit coverage and source variety, lose marks that were available for free. A plan that fixes diagrams, command terms, the HL extensions and the portfolio in that order tends to move more marks per hour than one that re-teaches the syllabus from unit one.
bullets: Diagrams: label axes and units, mark the shift, refer to it in the text
Command terms: evaluate means judge, not list
HL extensions: multiplier, Phillips curve, Gini, tariff and exchange-rate arithmetic
Portfolio: three units, three sources, three key concepts, rubric requirements met

process.title: Tell us the component, not just the subject
process.description: Say whether the priority is the four units, Paper 2 technique, the HL policy paper or the portfolio, and say which level. Component scope is the biggest driver of what the hour costs and of which tutors are a sensible match, so naming it in the first message saves a wasted trial lesson.

process.title: See the tutor's subject and level before you book
process.description: You see who is teaching, at what level, and which components they have taught before the first session is scheduled. For Economics HL that means confirming Paper 3 and portfolio experience specifically, because a tutor can be strong on the four units and have never marked the policy paper.

process.title: Take the free trial lesson
process.description: The first lesson is free and is used as a diagnostic rather than a sales call. Bring a marked script or a commentary draft if there is one. By the end of it you should have a named weakness and a count of sessions, not a brochure. There is no card requirement and no commitment attached.

process.title: Fix the slot around the school run and Ramadan
process.description: Sharjah evenings are short. Pick a recurring slot in Gulf Standard Time that survives a Dubai commute, and agree in advance how it shifts during Ramadan, when post-Iftar sessions hold far better than late-afternoon ones. A slot that moves every week is the main reason tutoring plans quietly stop.

process.title: Review against marked work, not impressions
process.description: Progress is read off annotated scripts and criterion-level commentary feedback, not off how the sessions felt. Agree at the start what gets marked and how often, and ask whether marking time sits inside the quoted rate. If after a few weeks the marked work is not moving, change the tutor rather than adding hours.

whyPoints.title: The AED numbers are on the page
whyPoints.description: Three of the six ranking providers in this market publish no price at all and two quote in US dollars. Every band on this page is in AED, attributed to the provider or rate tracker that published it, and dated October 2026. You can argue with a sourced number; you cannot plan against a withheld one.

whyPoints.title: Component-level matching, not subject-level
whyPoints.description: Economics HL is four jobs: units, Paper 2 technique, the HL policy paper and the portfolio. We match on the component you need rather than on the subject name, because the tutor who sequences the four units well is not automatically the one who can diagnose a Paper 3 script.

whyPoints.title: One tutor, kept
whyPoints.description: The same tutor week to week, so the diagram habits, the command-term work and the commentary history accumulate instead of restarting. If the match is wrong you change tutor once and keep the history; what you do not do is rotate through a pool and explain the student again every month.

whyPoints.title: The academic-honesty line is stated, not implied
whyPoints.description: A tutor teaches, reviews and gives feedback on the student's own work. Nobody supplies text for a commentary, an Extended Essay or a TOK essay. One operator in this market sells completed Internal Assessments; that is a malpractice trigger that falls on the student, which is exactly why the boundary is published here.

whyPoints.title: Online because of the subject, not as a compromise
whyPoints.description: The specialist pool for an HL policy paper is small everywhere and effectively absent within driving distance of most Sharjah addresses, and non-existent in Khor Fakkan and Kalba. Live one-to-one video removes the map from the matching problem. IB Gram does not offer home visits in the UAE at all.

whyPoints.title: Regulators explained, never borrowed
whyPoints.description: SPEA, KHDA, ADEK and MoHRE are described on this page with their own published wording and linked to their own pages. IB Gram claims no permit, accreditation, licence or partnership from any of them, and neither should any provider that cannot show you the number.

faqs.question: How much does an IB DP Economics HL tutor cost per hour in Sharjah?
faqs.answer: Market rates for an IB specialist working online in this market run roughly AED 200 to 450 an hour, with premium named tutors quoted higher - one provider publishes AED 650. A qualified subject tutor without Diploma-level component depth sits nearer AED 150 to 300, and budget general tutors run AED 45 to 150. In-home visits with travel are quoted at AED 180 to 500. Those bands are published provider and rate-tracker figures as of October 2026, not an IB Gram price list. Our own rate depends on the tutor, level, component and session length, and the first lesson is free so you compare against a real session.

faqs.question: Why is Economics HL quoted higher than Economics SL in Sharjah?
faqs.answer: Because HL contains a component SL does not sit. Paper 3, the policy paper, is Higher Level only and carries 30 per cent of the grade: two compulsory questions worth 30 marks each, mixing calculation with a defended policy recommendation. The pool of tutors who have actually marked Paper 3 against the published criteria is much smaller than the pool who can teach the four units competently, and that scarcity is what you are paying for. An HL quote that matches an SL quote is usually a signal that Paper 3 is not covered.

faqs.question: Does IB Gram send an Economics tutor to our home in Sharjah?
faqs.answer: No. IB Gram does not offer home visits anywhere in the UAE - that is a service we run only in India. Sharjah lessons are delivered one-to-one over live video in Gulf Standard Time, with the same tutor each week. The in-home market does exist here and is quoted at roughly AED 180 to 500 an hour with travel, and for a common subject in a dense community like Muwaileh it can work well. For an HL policy paper, the specialist you need is unlikely to live within a 20-minute drive of any particular Sharjah address, and on the east coast nobody does.

faqs.question: What exactly does the Economics Internal Assessment portfolio involve?
faqs.answer: Three commentaries, each a maximum of 800 words, each based on a published news article the student selects, each drawn from a different unit of the syllabus and engaging a different key concept. Each commentary is marked out of 14 across five criteria - diagrams, terminology, application and analysis, key concept and evaluation - and the portfolio carries 45 marks in total once the rubric requirements are counted. At HL it is 20 per cent of the grade; at SL it rises to 30 per cent. Most marks are lost to summarising the article instead of applying theory to it.

faqs.question: Can a tutor help with my child's Economics commentaries without crossing a line?
faqs.answer: Yes, within a boundary that should be stated rather than assumed. A tutor can teach the criteria, explain what a key concept has to do in a commentary, show how a diagram earns its marks, and give criterion-by-criterion feedback on a draft the student wrote. A tutor must never supply sentences, rewrite a draft, or choose and summarise the article. One operator in this market sells completed Internal Assessments outright; under IB rules that exposes the student to a malpractice finding affecting their whole Diploma, not just one grade.

faqs.question: How many Economics HL sessions does a Sharjah student usually need?
faqs.answer: It depends almost entirely on when you start. A DP1 student taking one weekly session alongside the school's teaching order typically uses 25 to 30 sessions across the year and buys fewer total hours than a DP2 student who starts in February. A targeted block is smaller: six to eight sessions to repair diagrams and terminology, eight to twelve for Paper 3 technique, three per commentary for portfolio work. A final eight-week programme runs 16 to 24 sessions and is the most expensive way to buy the same marks.

faqs.question: Which Sharjah areas do your Economics tutors cover?
faqs.answer: All of them, because lessons are delivered over live video rather than by road. In practice we work with students in Al Majaz, Al Nahda, Al Khan, Muwaileh, University City, Al Zahia, Al Qasimia, Halwan, Tilal City and the east-coast towns of Khor Fakkan and Kalba. What changes by area is not availability but timing: a student at a Dubai school living in Al Nahda is rarely free before 7pm on a weekday, while a Muwaileh student at a local campus can often take a 5.30pm slot.

faqs.question: Who regulates private schools in Sharjah, and does that affect tutoring?
faqs.answer: The Sharjah Private Education Authority regulates private education in the emirate, and along with Ras Al Khaimah's Department of Knowledge it approves tuition fees, curricula, programmes, courses, activities and assessment methods. It does not regulate private tutors; that sits with MoHRE through the private tuition work permit. The practical effect for a Sharjah family is calendar confusion rather than cost: if your child attends a Dubai school, the term dates, assessment calendar and inspection report all follow KHDA while you live under SPEA.

faqs.question: Do private tutors in Sharjah need a permit from the government?
faqs.answer: Yes. Private tutoring in the UAE is regulated by permit: the MoHRE private tuition work permit was introduced by Ministerial Resolution No. 710 of 2023 and is granted free of charge for two years. Eligible applicants include teachers at government or private schools, government and private-sector employees, unemployed residents, university students, and school students aged 15 to 18. Individuals tutoring without one are subject to fines and penalties under the applicable laws; no fine schedule is published, so treat any specific figure you are quoted as invented. Apply through the MoHRE app, website or e-services.

faqs.question: Is the HL policy paper really worth paying a specialist rate for?
faqs.answer: On the arithmetic, usually yes. Paper 3 is 30 per cent of the HL grade, it exists only at HL, and its question structure repeats enough that technique transfers quickly once somebody who has marked it shows the student what earns the marks. A generalist teaching it badly costs the same hourly rate and produces answers that show calculation without units and recommendations without defended trade-offs. If your budget forces a choice, spending it on Paper 3 and the portfolio covers half the grade between them.

faqs.question: How do sessions work during Ramadan and the Sharjah school run?
faqs.answer: They move, deliberately, and they are agreed in advance rather than cancelled week by week. During Ramadan, post-Iftar slots at around 9pm or 9.30pm Gulf Standard Time hold far better than late afternoon, and online delivery is what makes that time workable at all. Outside Ramadan, the Sharjah constraint is the commute: students at Dubai schools living in Al Nahda, Al Majaz or Al Khan are usually free from 7.30pm. Saturday mornings are the most reliable recurring slot for anything needing ninety minutes, which includes every timed Paper 3 question.

faqs.question: What should I send when asking for an Economics HL tutoring quote?
faqs.answer: Four things, and the quote gets sharper immediately. The level, HL or SL. The component you want covered - units, Paper 2 technique, Paper 3 or the portfolio. The school's internal deadlines for the three commentaries, because those sit earlier than families expect. And a recent piece of marked work: a mock script or a commentary draft with the teacher's comments. Without the marked work, any provider is guessing at the diagnosis, and a guessed diagnosis is how families buy the wrong hours at the right price.

faqs.question: My child is eight weeks from the May session with no Paper 3 practice. Is it too late?
faqs.answer: It is late, not too late, and the plan has to change shape. Eight weeks will not re-teach the four units, so it should not try. It will cover Paper 3 structure, the HL quantitative extensions - multiplier, Phillips curve, Gini, tariff and exchange-rate arithmetic - and timed questions marked against the criteria, because those are mechanical and scorable. Expect scarcity pricing at the top of the specialist band in this window. Nobody can promise a particular grade from eight weeks, and any provider who does is describing something the IB does not allow them to deliver.

faqs.question: Are IB results recognised for university entry in the UAE, and does tutoring affect that?
faqs.answer: Recognition runs through Ministry of Education equivalency, which is a process the ministry operates and no tutoring provider performs or influences. On the British track the published requirement is five accredited GCSE or IGCSE subjects at no less than grade E or 3, with Arabic and Islamic Education excluded from that count, plus one A Level at no less than E or two AS Levels at the same grade. No IB points threshold has been published on a source we are willing to cite, so verify the IB route on moe.gov.ae or with your emirate's attestation authority. Tutoring is never a requirement for equivalency.

faqs.question: Can two Sharjah students share Economics HL sessions to lower the cost?
faqs.answer: Yes, where both sit the same level and the same school year, and ideally the same school so the internal deadlines align. Small-group rates in this market sit well below one-to-one per student, so a pairing is the clearest way to reduce cost per family without dropping to a tuition-centre class. The constraint is real: HL Paper 3 cannot be taught usefully to an SL student sitting in the same session, so we do not pair across levels. Both students' scripts still get marked individually.

sharjah/ib-dp-economics-hl-tutor.closingHeading: Start with the diagnosis, then the number
sharjah/ib-dp-economics-hl-tutor.closingBody: The sensible order for a Sharjah family is diagnosis first, price second. Book the free trial lesson, bring a marked Paper 2 script or a commentary draft, and let an Economics HL specialist name which of the four habits is costing the marks: diagrams, command terms, the HL quantitative extensions, or the portfolio. From that you get a component, a session count and a quote you can compare against the AED bands published on this page. Lessons run one-to-one over live video in Gulf Standard Time, with the same tutor each week, from Al Majaz to Khor Fakkan. No home visits, no promised grade, and no number we are not willing to source.

sharjah/ib-dp-extended-essay-tutor.tutorsIntro: The mentors below work on Diploma core components: research questions, source handling, argument structure, the reflections and viva preparation. Each is matched to the subject the essay is registered in, because a History essay and a Biology essay fail in different places.

intro.heading: What an Extended Essay actually costs a Sharjah family, and why quotes vary so much
paragraphs: A Sharjah parent asking about Extended Essay support is rarely asking for a term of weekly lessons. The essay is a single piece of work, roughly 40 hours of student effort, submitted once. So the honest unit of purchase is not a term - it is a stage. A topic-scoping conversation is one hour. Rescuing a research question that has already been approved and already failed is three. Reading a 4,000-word draft properly, against the criteria, and writing usable feedback on it is two to three hours of mentor time whether or not any of that time is spent in a lesson.

That is why quotes for the same essay arrive at wildly different numbers. Published market rates in the UAE run from roughly AED 45-150 an hour at the budget and university-student end, AED 150-300 for a qualified subject tutor working online, and AED 200-450 or more for an IB or IGCSE specialist. One UK-based agency publishes AED 270 an hour; one premium provider publishes AED 650. None of those figures is wrong. They are rates for different things, and most of them are quoted without saying how many hours the job takes - which is the number that decides what you actually pay.

Sharjah adds two specifics. The first is that the Sharjah Private Education Authority regulates private education in the emirate and, unusually among UAE regulators, approves tuition fees, curricula, programmes, courses, activities and assessment methods. A Sharjah school's fee structure is therefore a reviewed figure, which makes it a useful anchor when you are deciding what a private mentoring hour is worth alongside it. The second is geography: a large share of Sharjah Diploma candidates attend campuses in Dubai, commuting from Al Nahda, Al Majaz or Al Taawun. Their supervisor is 40 minutes away in traffic, and a supervisor meeting they cannot easily reach is one of the commonest reasons a Sharjah family starts paying someone else.

The essay itself is worth understanding before you price it. Thirty-four marks are available across five criteria. Criterion C, critical thinking, carries 12 of them on its own - more than a third of the essay - and it is the criterion that cannot be fixed in the last fortnight, because it is a property of the research question rather than of the prose. Criterion A, focus and method, carries 6. Criterion B, knowledge and understanding, carries 6. Criterion D, presentation, carries 4. Criterion E, engagement, carries 6 and is assessed from the reflections rather than the essay. Confirm the current mark allocation against the Extended Essay guide your child's cohort is working to; the IB revises these documents between cohorts.

What follows is priced in dirhams at published market bands, broken down by stage, by subject family and by how late you start. Every figure is presented as a market rate from a named band, not as an IB Gram price list. Our own position is a free trial lesson first, then a quote for the specific job, which is a different conversation from an hourly sticker. Lessons are delivered online, one to one, over live video. IB Gram does not send a mentor to a home address anywhere in Sharjah - that is a service we run only in India.

sharjah/ib-dp-extended-essay-tutor.programmesIntro: The Extended Essay belongs to the Diploma Programme core, but the research habit it tests is built earlier. Families in Sharjah usually meet it in one of these four places, and the support each needs is priced differently.

programmes.name: Diploma Programme
programmes.description: The two-year Diploma carries six subjects plus three core components. The Extended Essay is the independent research piece: a 4,000-word argument in one approved subject, supervised in school, marked externally. It is graded A to E and combines with Theory of Knowledge to award up to three of the 45 Diploma points. A grade E is a failing condition, which is why a weak essay costs more than three points - it can cost the Diploma.
programmes.countryNote: Sharjah's Diploma cohorts are small by Dubai standards, so a candidate writing in Psychology or Economics may be the only one in the year doing so. Supervision load falls on a teacher covering several subjects, and that is the gap private mentoring usually fills in this emirate rather than any shortage of teaching quality.

programmes.name: The Diploma core: Extended Essay, Theory of Knowledge and CAS
programmes.description: The three core components run alongside the six subjects and are the part of the Diploma most often left until it is expensive. The Extended Essay and Theory of Knowledge are graded and feed the same three-point matrix; CAS is a completion requirement. Buying support for the core is cheaper per point than buying it for a subject, because three points from the core cost far fewer hours than three grade boundaries across three papers.
programmes.countryNote: Sharjah schools set internal core deadlines months earlier than the IB's own submission window, and those internal dates are the ones that bind. Families who ask the coordinator for the written internal calendar in DP1 generally spend less, because the costly purchases are the ones made after a school deadline has already been missed.

programmes.name: Middle Years Programme
programmes.description: The MYP Personal Project in Year 11 is the closest thing to an Extended Essay a student meets before DP1. It demands a goal, a process journal, a product and a report, all assessed on criteria. Students who treated the Personal Project as a formality arrive in DP1 without a research habit, and the first Extended Essay deadline exposes it. Mentoring at MYP is cheap per hour and avoids the expensive rescue later.
programmes.countryNote: Several Sharjah campuses run the MYP and hand students to a Diploma in Dubai or Abu Dhabi, so the Personal Project and the Extended Essay are sometimes supervised by different schools entirely. Where that happens, nobody owns the continuity, and a mentor who has seen both tasks is doing a genuinely different job.

programmes.name: Career-related Programme
programmes.description: The Career-related Programme sets a Reflective Project rather than an Extended Essay. It is shorter, built around an ethical dilemma arising from the student's career-related study, and assessed on its own criteria. Parents who search for Extended Essay help and find themselves in a CP cohort are buying a different task: the research discipline transfers, the mark scheme does not, and a mentor who has only coached Extended Essays will misdirect the work.
programmes.countryNote: The Career-related Programme is thinly represented in Sharjah, which means a CP candidate has almost no peers to compare notes with and almost no local mentoring market. This is the clearest case in the emirate for online matching on subject expertise rather than on postcode.

sharjah/ib-dp-extended-essay-tutor.subjectsIntro: The essay is registered in one subject, and that choice changes both the mark profile and the hours. These are the registrations Sharjah candidates most often bring, with what each one costs in mentor time and where it leaks marks.

subjects.name: History
subjects.levels: Essay registered at HL or SL
subjects.description: A History essay needs a question with a defensible argument and a body of secondary sources that disagree with each other. Candidates lose criterion C marks by narrating rather than evaluating. Mentor hours go on historiography and on cutting the narrative, not on finding more sources. Usually the cheapest subject family to support well.

subjects.name: Economics
subjects.levels: Essay registered at HL or SL
subjects.description: Requires a real-world situation, a defined economic concept and diagrams that carry argument rather than decoration. The commonest failure is a question that cannot be answered with available data. Hours go on scoping and on quantitative honesty. A Sharjah-specific question - port throughput, retail rents, school fee regulation - is often stronger than a global one.

subjects.name: Biology
subjects.levels: Essay registered at HL or SL
subjects.description: Primary data raises the cost: an experimental Biology essay needs a protocol, a risk assessment, replication and a statistical test chosen before the data is collected. Where school laboratory access is limited, a database or secondary-data essay is the honest route. Hours go on method design and on uncertainty, and that work has to happen early.

subjects.name: Chemistry
subjects.levels: Essay registered at HL or SL
subjects.description: The hardest subject family to support late, because the chemistry has to be correct at a level above the taught course. Candidates lose marks for a question that is really a Year 11 practical in longer form. Mentor time goes on narrowing the question to something measurable and on error propagation in the results section.

subjects.name: Psychology
subjects.levels: Essay registered at HL or SL
subjects.description: Attractive to students and risky in practice. Primary research involving human participants brings ethical requirements that most school settings cannot clear, so the workable route is a critical review of published studies. Hours go on turning a topic into a question with competing evidence, and on resisting the urge to summarise textbooks.

subjects.name: English A: Language and Literature
subjects.levels: Essay registered at HL or SL
subjects.description: A literary or language essay needs a close-reading argument, not a theme hunt. The commonest cost is a text choice too thin to support 4,000 words. Mentor hours go on selecting the extracts the essay will actually analyse and on keeping the argument from collapsing into plot summary in the middle third.

subjects.name: Mathematics
subjects.levels: Essay registered at HL or SL
subjects.description: Rarely chosen and often rewarded, because the field is less crowded. A Mathematics essay must contain mathematics beyond the syllabus, properly explained, with the student's own worked development rather than a transcription. Hours go on checking that the mathematics is both correct and the candidate's own, and on presentation of notation.

subjects.name: Business Management
subjects.levels: Essay registered at HL or SL
subjects.description: Needs a forward-looking question about a real organisation and primary or secondary evidence to answer it. Candidates lose marks when the essay becomes a company profile. Mentor time goes on framing a question the available evidence can settle, which for a Sharjah-based organisation often means an interview that must be arranged weeks ahead.

subjects.name: World Studies
subjects.description: An interdisciplinary essay on a global issue examined through two subjects. It can score well and it can fail badly, because the two disciplines must genuinely interact rather than sit in separate halves. The highest-supervision option on the list, and the one most often chosen for the wrong reason - that no single subject appealed.

subjects.name: Arabic A and Arabic B
subjects.levels: Essay registered at HL or SL
subjects.description: An essay written in Arabic is assessed on the same criteria in that language, and it needs a mentor who reads the language at academic level. In Sharjah this is a thinner market than in Dubai, and it is one of the registrations where matching online rather than locally changes what is available at all.

subjects.name: Visual Arts
subjects.levels: Essay registered at HL or SL
subjects.description: A Visual Arts essay is an art-historical or theoretical argument, not a portfolio commentary. Candidates who expect to write about their own practice are usually in the wrong component. Hours go on building a question around works the student can actually see or access reproducibly, and on referencing images correctly for criterion D.

subjects.name: Physics
subjects.levels: Essay registered at HL or SL
subjects.description: Experimental Physics essays live or die on whether the quantity being measured can be measured to useful precision with school equipment. A simulation or data-analysis route is often stronger. Mentor time goes on uncertainty analysis, which is where most Physics essays lose both criterion B and criterion C marks at once.

sharjah/ib-dp-extended-essay-tutor.regionsTitle: Where Sharjah Extended Essay candidates actually live, and what changes locally
sharjah/ib-dp-extended-essay-tutor.regionsIntro: Sharjah is not one market. The side of the emirate a family lives on changes which school the candidate attends, how reachable the supervisor is, and when a session can realistically start on a weekday.

regions.name: Al Nahda
regions.note: Pressed against the Dubai border, and the clearest example of the cross-emirate pattern: many Al Nahda students attend Dubai campuses. A supervisor meeting means a trip back across Al Ittihad Road, and that journey is why evening online sessions here start at 19:00 rather than 17:00.

regions.name: Al Majaz
regions.note: Dense towers around Khalid Lagoon with a short run to both Sharjah and Dubai schools. Flats rather than villas, which matters for an essay needing a quiet recorded interview or a long uninterrupted drafting block. Public library access nearby is a genuine advantage for source work.

regions.name: Al Taawun
regions.note: Another border community with heavy commuter flow, and a candidate population split between Sharjah and Dubai campuses. Families here often discover the internal Extended Essay deadline late, because school communication reaches them through a campus they rarely visit in person.

regions.name: Muwaileh
regions.note: Close to several large Sharjah campuses and to University City, so school-run distances are short and after-school slots can start earlier. Science essays benefit here: proximity to the campus makes a second laboratory session practical in a way it is not from Al Nahda.

regions.name: Aljada and Al Zahia
regions.note: Newer master-planned districts with young school catchments and a growing Diploma cohort. Candidates often come from campuses that have only recently started authorising Diploma cohorts, so supervisor experience with a given subject registration can be genuinely thin.

regions.name: University City and Al Nouf
regions.note: Adjacent to the University of Sharjah and the American University of Sharjah. Candidates here have unusually good access to academic libraries, which is a real advantage for a History, Economics or Psychology essay built on published literature rather than primary data.

regions.name: Al Qasimia and Al Khan
regions.note: Older central districts with a mix of Indian, British and American curriculum schools and a long-established tutoring market. Expect more local in-home offers here than elsewhere in the emirate, and therefore more price variance between quotes for the same job.

regions.name: Khor Fakkan and Kalba
regions.note: The east coast exclaves, under the same SPEA regulation but two hours from the main city. No realistic local mentoring market for a specialist subject registration, and the clearest case in Sharjah for online delivery rather than a search for someone nearby.

regions.name: Al Suyoh and Tilal City
regions.note: Outer residential growth areas with longer school runs in both directions. Session timing here is set by the return journey rather than by the student's preference, and clustering two sessions at a weekend often costs less in practice than four scattered weekday hours.

schoolClusters.city: Sharjah campuses running the Diploma or the MYP
schoolClusters.note: Named for context only. Cohort size is the relevant fact: a Sharjah Diploma year group is often a fraction of a comparable Dubai one, so a candidate registering an essay in a less common subject may have no peer and a supervisor stretched across several registrations.

schoolClusters.city: Dubai campuses that Sharjah families commute to
schoolClusters.note: A large share of Sharjah Diploma candidates sit their papers at Dubai-licensed campuses regulated by KHDA rather than SPEA. That split matters for deadlines and for supervisor access, and it is the reason a Sharjah postcode tells you little about which calendar a family is actually working to.

schoolClusters.city: Where Sharjah Diploma leavers commonly apply
schoolClusters.note: Useful context for parents weighing what three core points are worth. Local admissions treat the Diploma total and the Higher Level grades as the primary signals; the Extended Essay grade matters mainly through the points it contributes and occasionally as evidence of research capacity.
schools: Universities abroad entered through the Diploma total

sharjah/ib-dp-extended-essay-tutor.modesIntro: Three ways to buy Extended Essay support, priced differently because they are different products. The stage your child is at usually decides which one is sensible rather than which one is cheapest per hour.

modes.title: Stage blocks: buy the job, not the term
modes.description: The most common arrangement for an essay. A block is scoped to one stage - question design, method design, draft review, reflections and viva preparation - with a fixed number of hours and a written output at the end. It suits a single submitted piece of work far better than an open-ended weekly slot, and it makes the total cost visible before you commit to it.
bullets: Each block names its hours and what you receive in writing
Draft review includes mentor reading time, which a bare hourly rate usually hides
Blocks can be bought out of order if a deadline has already moved
No block includes any writing of the essay itself

modes.title: Weekly one-to-one through DP1 and DP2
modes.description: A standing weekly hour from the term the essay is introduced until submission. More expensive in total than stage blocks and usually better value per mark, because criterion C is built over months rather than rescued in weeks. Families who also want subject support in the registered subject tend to choose this, since the same mentor can carry both without duplicating context.
bullets: Suits a candidate who has not yet settled a research question
Allows the reflections to be written at the points the IB intends
Session notes accumulate into a record of the student's own process
Pauses around mock weeks without losing the slot

modes.title: Single diagnostic session
modes.description: One hour on a finished or near-finished draft, with written feedback mapped to the five criteria and a short list of the changes worth making in the time left. The cheapest honest intervention available and the right first purchase for a family unsure whether they need anything at all. It is also the only sensible purchase inside the final fortnight before an internal deadline.
bullets: Written criterion-by-criterion notes the student can act on alone
Identifies whether the problem is the question or the prose
No commitment to further hours
Available for a draft in English or Arabic

sections.heading: What Extended Essay support costs in Sharjah, stage by stage
paragraphs: An Extended Essay is a fixed job with a known shape, so it can be priced by stage rather than by term. The table below takes the published market bands for the UAE - roughly AED 150-300 an hour for a qualified subject tutor working online and AED 200-450 or more for a Diploma specialist - and applies them to the five stages an essay actually passes through. The hours column is the useful one. Most quotes you receive will name a rate and leave the hours to your imagination, which is how an AED 200 hour becomes an AED 2,400 essay without anybody saying so.

Read it as a ceiling rather than a plan. Very few candidates buy all five stages. A student whose question is sound and whose school supervision is attentive may need nothing beyond a single draft review. A student who arrives in DP2 with a question that cannot be answered is buying stages one and two over again, which is the single most expensive position to be in and the one most easily avoided by spending one hour early.

Two cost lines in the table are routinely left out of quotes. The first is mentor reading time: a 4,000-word draft read properly against five criteria takes longer than the lesson that follows it, and a provider who charges only for contact time is either absorbing that cost or not doing the reading. The second is the reflections. They carry six marks, they are assessed from a form of no more than 500 words, and they are almost always written in a rush the night before a deadline, which is a cheap place to lose marks and a cheap place to protect them.
bullets: Hours, not hourly rate, is the number that decides what you pay
Stage one bought late is paid for twice
Draft review that excludes reading time is not draft review
The 500-word reflection form carries six of the 34 marks

sections.heading: Why the subject the essay is registered in changes the bill
paragraphs: Parents usually expect the level to drive the price. For an Extended Essay it does not - there is no Higher or Standard version of the essay. What drives the price is the registered subject, because subjects differ in how much of the work has to happen before a single word of argument is possible. A History essay needs a reading list. A Chemistry essay needs a measurable reaction, a risk assessment and equipment that exists in the school. Those are not the same purchase.

The pattern across the market is consistent. Essays built on published literature - History, Economics, English, Psychology as a critical review - are the cheapest to support properly, because the expensive early decisions are decisions about reading rather than about apparatus. Essays requiring primary data are dearer, and the cost is front-loaded: a method designed in week two is cheap, and the same method redesigned in week twelve because the first set of results was unusable is not. World Studies is the outlier, because an interdisciplinary question needs two subject perspectives to interact rather than alternate, and that integration is the part students cannot see is missing.

There is a Sharjah-specific line in this. Where a registration is uncommon in the emirate - Arabic A at academic level, Mathematics, Visual Arts theory - the local pool of people able to supervise it closely is small, and scarcity moves a quote more than subject difficulty does. That is also the clearest argument for matching on expertise rather than proximity: a candidate in Khor Fakkan registering a Mathematics essay is not choosing between a local specialist and an online one. There is no local specialist to choose.

sections.heading: Thirty-four marks, five criteria, and what each one costs to repair
paragraphs: If you are paying by the hour, it helps to know which marks the hours can still reach. The five criteria are not equally repairable late. Criterion C carries 12 marks for critical thinking and is largely decided by the research question: an essay asking a question that only has one answer cannot demonstrate evaluation however well it is written. By the time a full draft exists, criterion C is mostly fixed, and the money spent on prose polishing is buying criterion D.

Criterion A, focus and method, carries 6 marks and is also a question-level property, though a draft can still be re-framed around a sharper version of the same question if there are weeks rather than days left. Criterion B, knowledge and understanding, carries 6 and is the one most responsive to targeted reading - a student who has used the subject's own terminology loosely can be taught to use it precisely in a couple of sessions. Criterion D, presentation, carries 4 marks and is genuinely cheap to secure: consistent referencing, a contents page, correct labelling, no appendix doing the work of the body.

Criterion E, engagement, carries 6 marks and is assessed from the reflections rather than from the essay. This is the most mispriced criterion in the market. Six marks out of 34 is almost 18 per cent of the essay, and it is awarded for evidence of the student's own intellectual process - decisions taken, routes abandoned, what the setbacks taught them. A reflection written retrospectively to fill a box reads exactly like one. Dated, specific reflections written at the time cost almost nothing and are worth the same marks as a chunk of the argument.
bullets: Criterion C: 12 marks, set by the question, hardest to repair late

Criterion E: 6 marks, from the reflections, not from the essay

sections.heading: A tutoring dirham in context: Sharjah fees, SPEA and the marginal hour
paragraphs: Private tutoring is bought alongside a school fee that is already being paid, so the useful question is not whether an hour is expensive in the abstract but what it buys relative to everything else on the bill. Sharjah has a specific feature here. The Sharjah Private Education Authority regulates private education in the emirate and approves tuition fees, curricula, programmes, courses, activities and assessment methods. Fee levels in Sharjah are reviewed figures rather than free-market ones, which makes them a more stable benchmark than in markets where they are not.

For comparison on the Dubai side of the border, where many Sharjah Diploma candidates actually attend school, KHDA confirmed in May 2026 that there would be no increase in private school fees in the emirate for the 2026-27 academic year, under an economic incentives package valued at AED 1.5 billion within a AED 2.5 billion total. That matters to a Sharjah family with a child at a Dubai campus: the school line on the household budget is flat for the year, which is the context in which a new tutoring line is being considered.

The table below sets out the comparison honestly. Note what is not in it: an IB Gram price. We publish market bands because they are checkable, and we quote for a specific job after a free trial lesson rather than from a sticker. The one figure worth more attention than the rest is the bottom row. Three core points bought through the Extended Essay and Theory of Knowledge generally cost fewer hours than three subject grade boundaries, which is the arithmetic most families have never had put in front of them.

sections.heading: The Sharjah commute is a line item on an Extended Essay
paragraphs: In most emirates the online-versus-in-home question is about convenience. In Sharjah it is partly about which emirate the school is in. A family in Al Nahda or Al Taawun whose child attends a Dubai campus is already absorbing a cross-border journey twice a day on Al Ittihad Road or the E311. Adding a third journey - a supervisor meeting, a tuition centre, a mentor travelling in - is not a neutral decision about preference. It is an hour of someone's day, and in an in-home rate it is an hour somebody is paying for.

That is visible in the published numbers. In-home one-to-one visits in the UAE market run roughly AED 180-500 an hour including travel, against AED 150-300 for a qualified tutor working online. The gap is not a quality gap. It is a travel gap, and it compounds: a mentor with four in-home clients across Sharjah can fit fewer sessions into an evening than one working online, so the scarce evening slots go to whoever pays most for them. For a specialist subject registration, the practical effect in Sharjah is that the slot you want does not exist locally at any price.

Online one-to-one removes the travel from both sides and changes what the pool contains. An Extended Essay registered in Arabic A, Mathematics or Visual Arts theory needs someone who reads that subject at academic level. Matching on expertise rather than on driving distance is the whole argument, and it is a stronger argument in Khor Fakkan and Kalba than anywhere else in the emirate. Lessons run over live video with screen sharing, which for a research essay means the draft, the sources and the mentor's annotations are all on one screen and all saved.

sections.heading: Counting backwards from submission: when an hour is worth most
paragraphs: The deadline that binds a Sharjah candidate is almost never the IB's. It is the internal date the school sets so that supervisors can complete their own obligations before the external submission window. Schools in this emirate set those dates differently, and families who have the written internal calendar in hand from DP1 spend less than families who learn the date when it has nearly passed. Ask the Diploma coordinator for it in writing, and ask for the three reflection points as well, because those are the moments criterion E is actually earned.

No IB session or results date is published on this page. The IB's own assessment pages block automated checking, so nothing about the May or November window here has been confirmed from the source, and an unverified date on a page like this is worse than no date. Confirm every IB deadline with your child's coordinator or on ibo.org directly. What can be said with confidence is the shape: the essay is a DP1-into-DP2 task, the question should be settled before the long summer between the two years, and the reflections are spread across the whole period rather than collected at the end.

Where the money goes furthest is early and unglamorous. One hour spent testing whether a question can actually be answered is the highest-return hour available, because it is the hour that protects 12 criterion C marks and prevents the whole of stage one being bought twice. The lowest-return hours are the ones bought in the final fortnight, which can secure criterion D and tidy criterion B but cannot change what the essay is about. If you only ever buy one hour, buy it in DP1.

sections.heading: What the fee never buys, however much it is
paragraphs: The Extended Essay is the component where academic honesty is tested hardest, because it is the only one produced largely out of sight over many months. There is a clean line and it is worth having in writing before any money changes hands. A mentor may teach research method, explain the criteria, ask questions about an argument, point to where reasoning is thin, model referencing conventions and rehearse the concluding interview. A mentor may not produce text that appears in the essay, restructure the argument on the student's behalf, supply a research question as a finished item, or edit a draft to completion.

Some providers in this market sell the other thing. One operation found in research for these pages sells completed Internal Assessments outright. Buying that is an academic malpractice case against the student, not against the seller, and the consequence sits with the candidate. The IB's authenticity declaration is signed by the student, and the viva voce exists in part so a supervisor can satisfy themselves that the work is the student's own. A candidate who cannot discuss the decisions in their own essay has a problem no fee can solve.

School supervision has its own limits, and they are worth knowing so you can see what you are buying on top. Supervisors are permitted a defined amount of comment on one draft, and the rest of the support is conversation rather than annotation. That is by design. A paid mentor does not increase the amount of commenting a supervisor may do; what a mentor adds is time, subject depth and an outside reading. Anyone offering more than that is offering something the IB does not permit, and the person who pays for it is the student.
bullets: A mentor teaches method, asks questions and gives feedback on the student's own work
A mentor never supplies text, a finished question or a restructured argument
The authenticity declaration is signed by the candidate, not by any tutor
The viva voce tests whether the student can discuss their own decisions

sections.heading: Permits, invoices and the questions to ask before paying anyone
paragraphs: Private tutoring in the UAE is permitted work, not unregulated work. The private tuition work permit was introduced by Ministerial Resolution No. 710 of 2023 and is issued through the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation. It is granted free of charge for two years. Eligible applicants include teachers working in government or private schools, employees in the government and private sectors, unemployed residents, university students and school students aged 15 to 18. The official route is the service listed by MoHRE as 'Issuance of a New Work Permit - Private Tutor Licensing', applied for through the ministry's app, website and e-services system, with no fee and a stated two-working-day completion time.

Two consequences for a Sharjah parent. A tutor who tells you the permit is expensive and that the cost is inside your rate is describing something that does not exist - the permit is free. And individuals offering private tutoring without a permit are subject to fines and penalties under the applicable laws. No fine schedule has been published, so no figure is quoted here; a number circulating online could not be verified against any ministry source and should be treated with caution wherever you see it.

On invoices, ask three plain questions. Does the quoted figure include reading time for a draft, or only contact time? Is the figure per hour or per session, and how long is a session? And is the quote inclusive of any tax that applies - a question to put to the provider in writing, since the tax treatment of tuition is a matter for the Federal Tax Authority rather than for a tutoring page to assert. Separately, be careful of any offer routed through a non-UAE phone number as the only contact path, and of any claim of regulator endorsement. IB Gram holds no permit or accreditation from SPEA, KHDA, ADEK, the Ministry of Education, the IB or Cambridge, and says so plainly. Naming a regulator and explaining what it does is not the same as being endorsed by one.

sections.heading: What a grade rise is worth in points, and what it costs to buy
paragraphs: The Extended Essay does not produce points on its own. It combines with Theory of Knowledge in a matrix that awards up to three of the 45 Diploma points, and a grade E in either is a failing condition that can prevent the Diploma being awarded regardless of subject grades. So the value of a paid hour is not one grade letter in isolation - it is the movement in the matrix, plus the removal of a failing condition that would otherwise cost everything. Confirm the current matrix with your child's coordinator; it is published in the IB's assessment procedures and the IB revises those documents.

The arithmetic is worth seeing because it points money in an unexpected direction. Moving from a D to a C in the Extended Essay, with Theory of Knowledge steady, is usually a one-point movement and costs a handful of hours - mostly spent on criterion B and criterion D, which are the responsive ones. Moving from a C to an A is a larger job, because it requires criterion C marks, and criterion C is a question-level property. Meanwhile lifting a Higher Level subject by one grade generally means lifting performance across two or three papers. Three core points are routinely cheaper in hours than three subject points.

The one case where cost should not be the deciding factor is a candidate heading for an E. That is not a points conversation. It is a Diploma-award conversation, and it is the situation where a single diagnostic session on an existing draft is the most useful AED 150 to AED 450 a Sharjah family can spend, because it establishes quickly whether the problem is the prose, the question, or the fact that there is not yet an essay. No mentor can promise a grade, and anybody who offers one should be questioned on exactly that point.

process.title: Tell us the registration and the deadline
process.description: Two facts decide almost everything: the subject the essay is registered in, and the school's internal submission date. Send those with a short note on what exists already - a topic, a question, a draft, nothing. A Sharjah family with a child at a Dubai campus should say so, because the calendar that binds you is that school's.

process.title: Free trial lesson with a subject-matched mentor
process.description: One session at no charge, with a mentor who reads the registered subject at academic level. The purpose is diagnostic: whether the question will hold, whether the available evidence can answer it, and which criteria are currently at risk. You get that read whether or not you continue afterwards.

process.title: A quote for the job, not a rate card
process.description: After the trial we quote for the stages your child actually needs, with the hours named and the written outputs listed. If the honest answer is a single diagnostic session and nothing more, that is the quote. If the honest answer is that school supervision is already covering it, we say so.

process.title: Work in blocks against the school's dates
process.description: Sessions are timed to the internal calendar rather than to a fixed weekly slot, which suits a single submitted piece of work. Drafts and annotations stay on a shared screen and are saved, so what the mentor wrote in week four is still readable in week fourteen when the viva comes round.

process.title: Reflections and viva, then stop
process.description: The last stage is the one most families skip: writing the three reflections at their proper points, clearing presentation and referencing, and rehearsing the concluding interview. After submission there is nothing useful left to buy, and we end the engagement rather than extend it into the subject.

whyPoints.title: Prices quoted in dirhams, with the hours attached
whyPoints.description: Every figure on this page is a published market band from a named source, applied to a stated number of hours. Three of the six competitor pages researched for this project publish no price at all, and the two that do quote in US dollars. A Sharjah family transacts in AED and deserves to see the total, not the rate.

whyPoints.title: Matched on the registered subject, not on your district
whyPoints.description: An Extended Essay in Arabic A, Mathematics or Visual Arts theory needs a mentor who reads that field at academic level. Online delivery means the pool is the pool of specialists rather than the pool of people who can reach Al Suyoh by 17:00, which for several registrations is the difference between support and no support.

whyPoints.title: The honesty line stated before you pay
whyPoints.description: We teach method, question arguments and give written feedback on the student's own work. We do not supply text, finished research questions or restructured arguments. One operation in this market sells completed coursework outright; the malpractice case from that lands on the candidate, and we will not put a student there.

whyPoints.title: No claim of regulator or board endorsement
whyPoints.description: IB Gram holds no permit, accreditation or partnership from SPEA, KHDA, ADEK, the Ministry of Education, the IB, Cambridge or Pearson, and no page here implies otherwise. We explain what each regulator does because parents need to know, which is a different thing from borrowing its authority.

whyPoints.title: Sources cited, dates attached, nothing invented
whyPoints.description: Regulator positions here come from u.ae, web.khda.gov.ae and mohre.gov.ae. No IB exam or results date appears on this page, because the IB's own pages cannot be checked automatically and an unverified date would be worse than none. Where a figure could not be verified, including the fine schedule, it is left out.

whyPoints.title: A free trial before any commitment
whyPoints.description: One session at no charge with a subject-matched mentor, with no card required and no obligation to continue. For many Sharjah families the trial is the whole purchase: it establishes whether the research question holds, which is the one piece of information that changes what everything else costs.

faqs.question: What should a Sharjah family budget for Extended Essay support from start to submission?
faqs.answer: Budget by stage rather than by term. Published UAE market rates run roughly AED 150-300 an hour for a qualified subject tutor working online and AED 200-450 or more for a Diploma specialist. The five stages of an essay - question design, method or reading plan, draft review, reflections, viva preparation - typically total seven to fourteen hours. That puts a complete stage-block route between about AED 1,050 and AED 3,600 at those bands. A standing weekly hour across both Diploma years costs considerably more and is better value per mark only if it starts early. Most families spend far less than the full range, because few need all five stages.

faqs.question: Is Extended Essay coaching charged by the hour or by the draft?
faqs.answer: Both models exist in this market and they are not equivalent. An hourly figure usually covers contact time only, which hides a real cost: reading a 4,000-word draft properly against five criteria takes two to three hours before any lesson happens. A per-draft or per-stage price includes that reading and makes the total visible before you commit. Ask any provider directly whether reading time is inside the quoted figure. If the answer is no, add it yourself when you compare quotes, otherwise you are comparing a complete price against a partial one.

faqs.question: Does an essay in a science cost more to support than one in History?
faqs.answer: Usually yes, and the reason is where the work sits rather than how hard the subject is. A Biology, Chemistry or Physics essay needs a method, replication, a risk assessment and equipment that actually exists in the school, and all of that has to be settled before writing. Those hours are front-loaded, and a method redesigned after unusable results is paid for twice. Essays built on published literature - History, English A, Economics - concentrate their hours on question design and source evaluation, which is cheaper and more forgiving of a late start.

faqs.question: We live in Sharjah but our son's school is in Dubai. Does that change what we pay?
faqs.answer: It changes the calendar more than the price. The internal submission date that binds your son is set by his Dubai campus under KHDA, not by anything in Sharjah, and families who learn that date late are the ones who end up buying emergency hours. Practically, the commute also sets your session times: an Al Nahda or Al Taawun family is usually looking at a 19:00 start rather than 17:00 once the return journey on Al Ittihad Road is accounted for. Online delivery removes a third journey from the day entirely.

faqs.question: Our daughter's research question has been approved but clearly will not work. How many hours is a rethink?
faqs.answer: One to three hours if there is still time, and it is the best-value money in the whole process. A question that only has one answer cannot earn criterion C marks, and criterion C is 12 of the 34 available. Reworking it usually means keeping the subject area and narrowing to something with competing evidence and reachable sources. If a full draft already exists and the deadline is weeks away, a partial re-frame around a sharper version of the same question is often possible. If the deadline is days away, the honest advice is to protect criteria B and D instead.

faqs.question: Does SPEA set or approve what a private tutor in Sharjah can charge?
faqs.answer: No. The Sharjah Private Education Authority regulates private education in the emirate and approves tuition fees, curricula, programmes, courses, activities and assessment methods for private schools. That authority covers schools, not individual tutors. A private tutor's rate is a commercial matter between the tutor and the family. What SPEA's role does give you is a stable benchmark: school fees in Sharjah are reviewed figures rather than freely set ones, which makes them a useful comparison point when you are deciding what an extra private hour is worth alongside the fees already paid.

faqs.question: At what point in the two Diploma years is Extended Essay money best spent?
faqs.answer: Early and on the question. One hour spent testing whether a research question can actually be answered protects the 12 criterion C marks and prevents the whole of the scoping stage being bought a second time in DP2. The research question should be settled before the long break between the two Diploma years. Hours bought in the final fortnight can secure criterion D presentation marks and tighten criterion B, but they cannot change what the essay is about. If you only ever buy one hour, buy it in the first Diploma year.

faqs.question: Can we pay for a single session just to have a finished draft checked?
faqs.answer: Yes, and it is the most sensible first purchase for a family who is not sure they need anything. One hour on a complete draft, with written feedback mapped to the five criteria, establishes whether the problem is the prose, the question or the absence of an argument. At published market bands that is roughly AED 150-450 with no commitment to anything further. The output is a short list of changes the student can make alone. For a candidate at risk of a grade E it is the single most useful hour available.

faqs.question: How many hours does an essay with primary data usually need?
faqs.answer: More than a literature-based one, and the hours arrive earlier. Expect two to four hours on method design alone: what will be measured, how often, with what equipment, with what risk assessment, and which statistical test was chosen before any data was collected. Add the usual two to three hours of draft review and one to two on the reflections. Twelve hours across the project is common for an experimental science registration against six to eight for a History or Economics essay. The difference is almost entirely in the front half.

faqs.question: What does a tutoring quote in this market usually leave out?
faqs.answer: Three things. Reading time on a draft, which is where the real hours of a review sit. The number of hours the job actually takes, so you see a rate without a total. And whether the figure is per hour or per session, since a 45-minute session quoted hourly is not what it appears to be. Ask about all three in writing. On tax, ask the provider directly whether their figure is inclusive; the tax treatment of tuition is a matter for the Federal Tax Authority and not something a tutoring page should assert on your behalf.

faqs.question: Does the Extended Essay grade move the Diploma total enough to justify the spend?
faqs.answer: It can, and the arithmetic is more favourable than parents expect. The Extended Essay combines with Theory of Knowledge in a matrix awarding up to three of the 45 points, and a grade E in either is a failing condition that can stop the Diploma being awarded at all. Three points earned through the core generally cost fewer hours than lifting a Higher Level subject by three grades, because that means moving performance across two or three papers. Confirm the current matrix with your child's Diploma coordinator rather than relying on any third-party summary.

faqs.question: Are Extended Essay sessions better weekly, or clustered around deadlines?
faqs.answer: Clustered, for most candidates. The essay is a single submitted piece of work with distinct stages rather than a syllabus that needs covering, so a standing weekly hour often ends up filling time between the moments that matter. Two hours in the week a question is being settled are worth more than eight spread over two months. The exception is a student who has not yet found a question at all, or one taking subject tuition in the registered subject anyway, where a weekly slot lets criterion C build gradually instead of being rescued.

faqs.question: Is it cheaper to support the Extended Essay and Theory of Knowledge together?
faqs.answer: Often, because the two feed the same three-point matrix and a mentor who understands one has most of the context for the other. The saving is in shared context rather than a discounted rate: the same conversation about what counts as evidence, what an unsupported claim looks like and how to evaluate a source serves both components. Whether one mentor can cover both depends on the subject the essay is registered in. A science registration usually needs a subject specialist for the essay, with Theory of Knowledge handled separately.

faqs.question: Does an Extended Essay mentor in Sharjah need a MoHRE permit, and is its cost in our fee?
faqs.answer: A permit is required and it costs nothing. The private tuition work permit was introduced by Ministerial Resolution No. 710 of 2023, is issued by the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation, and is granted free of charge for two years. So any tutor telling you their rate carries the cost of a permit is describing an expense that does not exist. Ask to see the permit document before a first paid session. Individuals tutoring without one are subject to fines and penalties under the applicable laws, though no fine schedule has been published and no figure should be quoted to you.

faqs.question: Can a mentor collect or process our child's data to save time?
faqs.answer: No, and the saving would be worthless. The essay must be the candidate's own work, the authenticity declaration is signed by the student, and the viva voce exists partly so a supervisor can confirm the student can discuss their own decisions. A mentor may teach how to design a protocol, explain which statistical test suits a data set and show what a clean results table looks like. The student collects, enters and analyses. A candidate who cannot account for where a number came from has a problem that no amount of paid support can repair.

faqs.question: What happens if nobody is free who reads our child's registered subject?
faqs.answer: We say so rather than offering a near-match. For some registrations in Sharjah - Arabic A at academic level, Visual Arts theory, Mathematics - the pool is genuinely thin, and a general essay mentor placed on a specialist registration gives you confident advice about the wrong things. The honest options are a wait for the right person, a single diagnostic session with a generalist to triage criteria B and D only, or a clear recommendation that school supervision plus the student's own work is the better route. All three are preferable to a mismatch.

sharjah/ib-dp-extended-essay-tutor.closingHeading: Start with one hour on the research question
sharjah/ib-dp-extended-essay-tutor.closingBody: If your child's Extended Essay question is not yet settled, that is where a Sharjah family's money goes furthest: one hour, early, protecting the 12 marks that cannot be recovered later. If a draft already exists, a single diagnostic session will tell you whether the problem is the prose, the question or the argument, and what the remaining weeks can realistically reach. Either way the first session is free, matched to the subject the essay is registered in, and delivered online over live video on Gulf Standard Time. You will get a quote for the stages your child needs, with the hours named - not an hourly rate with the total left to guesswork.

sharjah/ib-dp-math-ai-sl-tutor.tutorsIntro: The tutors below cover Mathematics: Applications and Interpretation at Standard Level for Sharjah Diploma students. Each works the same way: a marked diagnostic first, then weekly timed questions, then exploration comments against the published criteria. You see who is teaching before you commit.

intro.heading: Judge an AI SL tutor on what comes back marked, not on what is promised
paragraphs: Mathematics: Applications and Interpretation SL is the DP maths course built around real data, modelling and a calculator. Two papers carry 80 per cent of the grade between them and the mathematical exploration carries the remaining 20 per cent. A Sharjah family looking for an IB DP Math AI SL tutor in Sharjah is usually reacting to one of three signals: a predicted grade that dropped a band, an exploration draft the supervisor sent back with a short note, or a mock paper where the arithmetic was right and the marks were not. None of those three is solved by more explaining. They are solved by looking at the script.

That is why this page is organised around evidence rather than reassurance. Every claim a tutoring page makes about progress should be checkable by you, on paper, within four weeks. A marked question set shows where method marks were awarded and where an answer earned nothing because the working jumped. A commented exploration draft shows which of the five criteria is actually holding the mark down, which is almost never the one a student assumes. A weekly session note shows whether the same topic keeps reappearing, which is the single most useful diagnostic a parent can hold.

Lessons are delivered online, one-to-one, over live video. IB Gram does not offer home visits in the UAE; home visits are a service we run only in India. For AI SL that constraint turns out to be an advantage rather than a compromise. The course is calculator-dependent in a way that AA is not, so a tutor who can share a screen, drive the same graphic display calculator emulator your child uses, and annotate a marked script live is doing something a tutor sitting at a kitchen table with a pen cannot do as cleanly. The marked work is saved, dated and sent, rather than left behind in a notebook.

Sharjah adds its own scheduling problem. A large number of families living in Al Nahda, Al Taawun and Al Majaz send children to schools across the Dubai border, and the return journey down Al Ittihad Road decides whether a four o'clock session is realistic or fictional. Families in Muwaileh, Al Zahia and University City have shorter runs but later activity schedules. Online slots can be set at 6.30pm or 8pm without a tutor's travel time being priced into the hour, and they can move during Ramadan without the week collapsing.

Private schools in Sharjah are regulated by the Sharjah Private Education Authority, which regulates private education in the emirate and approves tuition fees, curricula, programmes, courses, activities and assessment methods. That matters for a maths tutor in a practical way: your child's internal assessment calendar, reporting windows and mock timings are set inside a school working to SPEA's approved framework, and tutoring evidence is only useful if it arrives before those windows rather than after them.
